CoinTracker is the most accurate and trusted cryptocurrency portfolio tracker and tax software, trusted by more than 3 million people since 2017.

USE CRYPTO WITH PEACE OF MIND

Add your crypto wallets and exchanges to get a complete picture of your net worth, gains, losses, holdings, and more.

View all your crypto activity in one secure place.

Make smarter investment decisions with personalized insights and performance tracking tools.

FILE YOUR CRYPTO TAXES UNDER DONE

CoinTracker quickly and accurately calculates your cost basis and capital gains, saving you hundreds of hours of manual work. 

Automatically categorize all your DeFi transactions and remove spam transactions.

Maximize your tax refund with tax loss harvesting, tax lots breakdown, cost basis options and more. 

Generate and download tax forms in about 10 minutes.

File directly with TurboTax, H&R Block, or your own CPA.

SECURITY AT EVERY STEP

Read-only access to your wallets means you’re always in full control of your crypto.

End-to-end encryption and token-based two-factor authentication.

SOC 1 and SOC 2 certified.


ALL YOUR CRYPTO, ALL IN ONE PLACE

500+ crypto integrations

50K+ smart contracts

600+ dapps

400+ exchanges

70+ blockchains and wallets

show_hn.title: Show HN: CoinTracker (YC W18) on iOS and Android

quotes.text:
Hi — we’re Chandan and Jon, co-founders of CoinTracker (https://cointracker.io). CoinTracker is a cryptocurrency portfolio manager that automatically pulls balances and transactions from top exchanges and wallets, and delivers tax information to users.

About five months ago we launched CoinTracker web on Hacker News (https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=16386419). We really appreciated all the kind words and have been hard at work trying to improve with the features you requested. The top request was to bring CoinTracker to iOS & Android, so we’re excited to announce our mobile apps are now live:

Android: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=io.cointracker.android

iOS: https://itunes.apple.com/us/app/cointracker-crypto-portfolio/id1401499763

We would love to get your feedback on the apps and on how we could further improve CoinTracker for you.
